prd.title: PRD 3: Roommate matching — a structured waiting list, mutual matching and an English bot

tasks.title: Roommate entry: /mate, the start button, mate links, bans, one open intake and usernames (FR-2 handler, FR-3, FR-14)
acceptance: openRoommate(ctx, chat, locale, entry) implements the six cases of spec 06 §Entry and routing in that order; /mate, the rm:start button (added to the start and startAfterPayload replies) and handleStart's { kind: 'roommate' } all call it

A new draft sends one tg_roommate_flow_started with entry_source (bot_menu for /mate and rm:start) and entry_detail only when present, the intro with the privacy link and the districts step; an existing draft resends its step without a second event

One open intake per chat both ways: the roommate intake does not start while the deposit intake is open, and the deposit start (dep link, dep:start, the keyword offer) does not start while a roommate draft or edit step is open, each with its /cancel line

handleText routes typed text to an open roommate step that takes text; at a button-only step, or for text that step cannot use, the text goes on to the district check or address lookup with the '/cancel leaves the roommate questions' line (spec 06 §Entry and routing); /cancel deletes a draft or clears an edit step and otherwise behaves as today

Every roommate handler stores ctx.from.username (or null) on the chat's profile when it differs (spec 07 §Usernames), through one helper, answers its callback query and ignores 'message is not modified'

A banned chat that still has its hidden profile gets the FR-14 reply with 'Delete my profile' (spec 06 rule 1); bot.catch logs only the error message and update type, with a test that no chat id or text reaches the log (spec 06 §Boundaries)
Tests for every case listed under 'Tests' in spec 06 §Entry and routing, with a fake context and mocked Prisma; a banned chat sends no roommate event

tasks.title: Roommate daily cron: route, two schedules, the send hour and housekeeping (FR-15, FR-12 criterion 4, D55, D68)
acceptance: GET /api/cron/roommate-daily guarded by requireCronAuth (401 without it), with the two vercel.json entries 0 8 * * * and 0 9 * * *

Every run does the housekeeping of spec 06 §Daily cron step 1: drafts after 7 days, edit steps after 24 hours, expiry with one tg_roommate_profile_expired, deletions with one tg_roommate_profile_deleted (reason expired or moderation), each per-row conditional so a doubled run sends each event once; messages run only when isRoommateSendHour(now), in the priority order of step 2; the response holds counts only and flushPostHog is awaited

roommate-daily.ts holds a shared claim-send-release helper for every cron message (blocked chats skipped, conditional claim, 403 marks the chat blocked, other errors release the claim, a 429 releases and stops the run, at most 25 a second, MAX_MESSAGES_PER_RUN, no new send after SEND_BUDGET_MS), used by every later message job
No bot configured → housekeeping only

Tests with mocked Prisma, a fake api and a fixed now: 401, each housekeeping kind and its event, no message outside the send hour, the helper's claim-once, release and 403 paths, and the vercel.json entries

tasks.title: Per-person split without studios, if the owner says so (Q-17, D61)
acceptance: The per-person line uses the apartment set the owner chose, through one filter in the line's function, with its own N and level, and the golden case updated
The figure contract's loaders gain the filter only if the answer needs it, with a consistency test against the checker
tasks.notes: Blocked: Q-17 (prd-3-decision-review.md, architect gaps). D61 builds 'for two people about X each' from the tenant all-in median of whole apartments, studios included; halving a studio's median can overstate what two people sharing can expect, and the loaders have no rooms filter today. T080 builds the line exactly as D61 says. Options: (a) only apartments with 2 or more rooms (a rooms filter in the loader; fewer reports, so the line appears less often); (b) keep D61 as built; (c) drop the line. Proposal: (a). An honesty rule for displayed figures, so the owner decides.

tasks.title: The opt-in's closing promise for profiles that expire first (Q-18, D64)
acceptance: The opt-in confirmation and the closing route follow the owner's answer in ru, uk and en; the promise check still names the backing code

tasks.notes: Blocked: Q-18 (prd-3-decision-review.md, architect gaps). D64's sentence 'If matching does not open, we'll tell you and delete your profile' is built as worded (T084), but a profile that expires and is deleted 14 days later (D55) before the owner runs the closing route gets no closing message, so the promise is not kept for it. Proposal: (a).
